result.description: RMS Electrical (AUS.) PTY LTD  We at, RMS Electrical (AUS.) Pty Ltd, are looking for a talented and driven Electrical Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining electrical systems and equipment, while ensuring adherence to industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements.   Benefits   Competitive salary package based on qualifications and experience.  Career growth and professional development opportunities.  Ongoing training and skill enhancement programs.  Supportive and collaborative work environment.  Health and wellness benefits (where applicable).  Paid annual leave and public holidays.  Performance recognition and reward programs.  Access to modern engineering tools and technologies.  Opportunities to work on challenging and innovative projects.  Flexible work arrangements were operationally feasible.    Task & responsibilities   Design, develop, and maintain electrical systems, equipment, and components.  Prepare electrical drawings, schematics, specifications, and technical documentation.  Conduct testing, inspections, troubleshooting, and fault-finding activities.  Ensure compliance with electrical codes, industry standards, and safety regulations.  Support installation, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical equipment.  Monitor project progress and provide technical guidance to project teams.  Analyze electrical system performance and recommend improvements.  Coordinate with clients, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.  Prepare project reports, cost estimates, and engineering calculations.  Participate in risk assessments and implement preventive measures to ensure workplace safety.  Assist in planning and executing electrical engineering projects within budget and schedule requirements.  Provide technical support and training to operational and maintenance teams as required.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline.  At least 1 year of experience in electrical engineering, design, maintenance, testing, or project execution (or as required).  Strong knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution, control systems, and relevant engineering principles.  Experience with electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.  Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, ETAP, MATLAB, or similar tools.  Familiarity with applicable electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.  Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.  Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet project deadlines.  Experience in industrial, commercial, manufacturing, construction, or infrastructure projects is an advantage.  Professional certifications or engineering registration/licensing (where required) will be highly regarded.  Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites if required.   About Company     RMS Electrical (AUS.) Pty Ltd is a trusted Australian electrical services company committed to delivering high-quality, reliable, and innovative electrical solutions across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Based in Melbourne, Victoria, we take pride in providing exceptional workmanship, maintaining the highest safety standards, and exceeding client expectations on every project. At RMS Electrical, we value professionalism, integrity, teamwork, and continuous improvement. Our experienced team is dedicated to delivering efficient and cost-effective electrical services while fostering strong relationships with clients, partners, and communities. We are passionate about supporting employee growth and creating a positive workplace culture where individuals are respected, encouraged to develop their skills, and empowered to succeed. By combining technical expertise with a customer-focused approach, we continue to build a reputation for excellence and reliability within the electrical industry.
